scenario: Ordinary staged publication of exact advisory review records without new fault injection

stages.label: durable-intent-fixes-a-whole-review
stages.explanation: Two ordinary prepare requests fix complete advisory reviews; exact replay recovers a discarded response, status preserves controls, and the old reader refuses the unpublished target.

stages.label: two-launched-callers-advance-one-fixed-write
stages.explanation: Two step processes start before reply collection and return unordered ready/linked states. The old reader refuses the two-link state; a third step completes publication and historical readers become compatible.

stages.label: prepared-write-completes-without-live-inputs
stages.explanation: With fourteen old live paths absent, a prepared job advances ready/linked/completed from its durable intent. Status recovers a discarded ready reply; old show/record and completed prepare replay remain source-free. Every path returns in finally.

stages.label: compatible-review-keeps-old-assessment
stages.explanation: Completed files are ordinary review records: old show and separate revalidation retain the full original plans. Minimum keeps two unknown-identity holds and long keeps four holds; matching basis authorizes no domain action.

stages.label: different-requests-do-not-rebind-an-intent
stages.explanation: Five malformed inputs and five different exact requests refuse without creating unsupported targets or changing either completed job. The immutable operation, actor, verdict, plan and target remain fixed.

stages.label: publication-preserves-prior-domain-history
stages.explanation: Both completed statuses, previous reviews, source plans, catalog pages, case details and blocked jobs remain consistent. Source/live history is unchanged, and no domain action, new fault worker or injected partial write occurs.

limits: This ordinary product workflow introduces no fault callback, injected partial write, forced interruption or new fault worker. Staging-prefix recovery is implemented separately and is not exercised here.

Two ordinary step processes are launched before either reply is collected and return successive ready/linked states. Temporal overlap, lock wait duration, throughput and production capacity are not measured.
Each durable intent fixes one complete self-declared advisory review. Completion preserves old review format, identity, operation, clock, actor, verdict, plan and all original reasons.
Prepared, ready and linked states do not provide an old-reader result. The old reader refuses until the proven staging alias is removed and the final record has one link.
Before a complete durable intent exists, bootstrap directories, empty staging and partial intent remain outside supported continuation; this scenario does not construct or repair them.

After preparation, status, step and exact prepare replay use captured job controls without live plan, catalog, case, attempt or source bundle reads. Fourteen original paths return in finally; old blocked jobs never move.

An actual prepare reply is discarded and recovered by exact replay. An actual ready step reply is discarded and recovered through status without repeating a state-changing step. Comparison digests remain unpublished.

Source/live public Store comparison excludes only top-level governance observed_at. New write-job and review metadata are separate from domain history; no new restoration, grant, credential, archival or deletion occurs beyond baseline.
Actors and verdicts do not establish authentication, independent expertise, semantic truth or authorization. Matching basis revalidation is separate from publication and authorizes no action.
No power failure, storage failure, new SIGKILL schedule, arbitrary partial control repair, noncooperating file owner or full concurrency schedule is demonstrated.
